notes: Study design inferred (BRFSS repeated cross-sections with 2017 vs 2021 change); the report names no design. Between-group 'higher' claims in 2021 rest on no stated test or overlap rule, so no procedure is recorded for them. Figure quintiles are quantization.
view_issues: Text says medication use 'did not decrease significantly in any state', but table p-values for decreases are all >0.05 while some increases (e.g., North Carolina 4.7, p=0.505) are not significant; state counts of increases are not traceable to a stated rule.
